source_title: Agent Harnesses are Dead, Long Live Agent Harnesses
claim_summary: CEO post argues agent harnesses/frameworks are becoming interchangeable and says to expect launches soon; value claimed to shift to systems that learn from real workflows
limitation: Opinion/positioning by vendor CEO; no deliverable, date or measurable claim to verify

claim_summary: Release notes list checkpoint resume/diff/prune CLI commands, from_checkpoint on Agent.kickoff, checkpoint forking with lineage tracking, reasoning/cache token accounting and enterprise A2A docs
limitation: Release-note listing only; checkpoint correctness and resume fidelity not independently exercised

claim_summary: Adds E2B and Daytona sandbox tools, checkpoint/fork for standalone agents, checkpoint lifecycle events, Bedrock V4; notes claim MCP SDK cold start reduced ~29%; lxml and python-dotenv security bumps
limitation: The ~29% cold-start figure is a vendor note without published benchmark protocol; sandbox security depends on third-party provider

claim_summary: Custom persistence key in @persist, Azure OpenAI Responses API support, Tavily research tools, You.com MCP tools; litellm bumped for an SSTI fix while one pip CVE is noted as unfixable and ignored
limitation: Release notes explicitly ignore one unfixable pip CVE; residual dependency risk not assessed here

claim_summary: Vendor launches Discovery, a use-case recommendation engine said to match a company description against production execution patterns; post says it is live for every CrewAI user
availability: vendor-stated live on hosted platform; proprietary
limitation: Recommendation quality and 'more adoption' outcomes are unquantified vendor/customer anecdotes; requires hosted account

claim_summary: Deprecates CrewAgentExecutor and defaults Crew agents to AgentExecutor; adds restore_from_state_id kickoff parameter; extracts CLI into standalone crewai-cli package; adds crew-to-flow migration guide
limitation: Behavioral change of default executor may alter downstream results; migration cost not measured

source_title: VU#221883: CrewAI contains multiple vulnerabilities including SSRF, RCE and local file read (revision 3)
claim_summary: CERT/CC note on CVE-2026-2275/2285/2286/2287 last revised 2026-05-20 with vendor statement that all issues are fixed: CodeInterpreterTool removed and URL/path validation added
limitation: Original note published 2026-03-30 and fixes merged 2026-04-07 are OUTSIDE the window; only the May 20 revision is in-window; note's older Solution text still says no complete patch

claim_summary: Release adds Agent Control Plane docs with an ACP (Beta) navigation block; also hardens StdioTransport against environment-variable leakage and gates Skills Repository behind CREWAI_EXPERIMENTAL
availability: ACP labelled Beta on hosted AMP; skills experimental
limitation: ACP is a hosted proprietary feature documented, not exercised; beta scope and plan limits unverified

source_title: How to build Agents Where Data Already Lives
claim_summary: Vendor describes deeper Snowflake integration: agents connect to Snowflake managed MCP server, Cortex Analyst/Search/Agents as tools, and Snowflake Cortex as governed model-access path
availability: vendor-stated; AMP subscription required per docs
limitation: Customer counts ('hundreds of thousands of agents') unverified; Snowflake-side confirmation not checked; announcement date of Dev Day not pinned

claim_summary: Pluggable default backends for memory/knowledge/rag/flow, chat API for conversational flows, native Snowflake Cortex LLM provider, per-run runtime state isolation; pip-audit CVEs resolved for aiohttp/docling
limitation: Feature list only; interoperability of pluggable backends not independently tested

source_title: Stop giving your agents database credentials
claim_summary: Vendor adds Databricks as a managed AMP integration with four managed MCP servers and recommends governed tools instead of raw database credentials; DatabricksQueryTool row limit in crewai-tools
availability: vendor-stated managed integration (AMP); OSS tool separate
limitation: Security benefit asserted, not tested; Databricks-side confirmation not checked

claim_summary: Declarative FlowDefinition (unified loading, each/if actions, crew and agent actions), JSON-first crew projects, DMN mode; fixes owner-only credential-file permissions and symlink path traversal in skill archive extraction
limitation: Security fixes self-reported in notes without separate advisory; declarative format stability unknown

claim_summary: Release fixes SSRF redirect bypass in scraping fetches (PR #6331) later published as CVE-2026-62240; also git init for generated projects and explicit project definitions
limitation: Fix shipped before public advisory; affected deployments and exploitation unknown

claim_summary: Third-party benchmark (2,000 runs, 5 tasks, one model gpt-5.2) reports CrewAI with the heaviest token/latency profile, ~3x tokens and time of LangChain on a single tool call and max_iter stalls
availability: independent test; CrewAI version not stated
limitation: Page shows 'updated on Jul 6 2026' (living page, later edits); single model/dataset, undisclosed CrewAI version and iteration caps limit reproducibility

source_title: crewai-tools SSRF redirect bypass exposes internal services
claim_summary: GHSA-mr4r-hcgx-8p4h / CVE-2026-62240 (High): validate_url checked DNS once then returned the original URL, allowing redirect or DNS-rebinding SSRF to internal/metadata endpoints; crewai-tools below 1.15.1 affected
limitation: GitHub page shows 2026-07-14 and NVD publication 2026-07-13; exploitation in the wild not established

claim_summary: Adds generic interception-hook dispatcher and step/execution-boundary interception points; makes tool-result caching opt-in instead of default; reports per-call usage metrics
limitation: Default change (caching off) may alter cost/latency comparisons with earlier versions

claim_summary: Bumps bedrock-agentcore dependency to patch CVE-2026-16796; Responses API tool-calling fixes; skill usage events
limitation: Transitive dependency CVE; CrewAI-specific exposure not described

source_title: Crew Studio: The Automated Agent Builder
claim_summary: Vendor says Studio shipped: prompt-to-Flow builder with single-agent, crew and router nodes, 1,000+ connectors, org agent repository for reuse, flow export as source code, run/trace/deploy
limitation: Same-day CEO post; '700K+ use-case patterns' and customer execution counts are unverified vendor figures; exported-code portability untested

claim_summary: Adds project_id to link OSS usage to an enterprise account, detects coding agents in telemetry, surfaces AMP in scaffolded AGENTS.md; IBM Db2 search tool; bumps aiohttp/cryptography for six GHSA advisories
limitation: Privacy/consent implications of telemetry linkage not reviewed; opt-out behaviour not verified here

source_title: Crew Studio launches with native Arize AX tracing and evaluation
claim_summary: Partner reports Crew Studio traces can be sent to Arize AX via OTLP without custom instrumentation, feeding evaluation and labeling loops
limitation: Arize page displays only 'August 2026'; exact day 2026-08-13 taken from plushcap aggregator; partner is commercially interested

claim_summary: Adds now() to CEL expression environment, injectable client for platform tools, Clipper integrations client; bumps pypdf and nltk for security vulnerabilities; Snowflake CVE floor
limitation: Security bumps listed without advisory IDs in notes

claim_summary: Adds telemetry tracking checkpoint runtime and CLI usage; docs clarify tracing is managed separately from telemetry; UTF-8 checkpoint persistence fix
limitation: Telemetry scope/consent not independently reviewed

claim_summary: Adds llm_overlay context variable to route agent roles to models, human-feedback/pause events in tracing, platform tools in JSON crew wizard; rejects replay when stored tasks differ; text URLs via safe fetcher
limitation: Routing benefits on cost/quality not measured

claim_summary: Adds crewai eval (markdown brief for agents; exit code 1 unless gate passed; --models with llm_overlay) plus EXPERIMENTAL job lifecycle/runner and turn/reply identities; Oracle integrations; dependency advisories addressed
availability: stable release; some features labelled experimental
limitation: Eval gate semantics and test independence not verified; experimental items are preview-grade
